title: Kwan-yin

The interplay of the acolytes’ songs and the priests’ chants highlights a deep yearning for connection and relief from anguish, ultimately questioning the efficacy of mercy in the face of overwhelming suffering. The climax reflects Kwan-yin's confession of being defeated, raising poignant questions about the nature of hope and the significance of mercy in a world filled with despair.
